notes.title: Photo Mode & Contest!
notes.content: [h2]The End of the Sun featured on the Steam front page - Daily Deal![/h2][p][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We've got some incredible news to share! [b]The End of the Sun[/b] has been featured on the [b]Steam Daily Deal[/b] [b]front page[/b]! [/p][p]This is a huge honor for us, and we're celebrating by offering a fantastic, [b]our biggest so far![/b][/p][p]If you've been waiting to dive into the game's fantasy open world, now's the perfect chance![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/912840/The_End_of_the_Sun/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]But that's not all – we have [b]one more surprise[/b] for you![/p][p][/p][h2]PHOTO MODE - UPDATE 2.0[/h2][p][/p][p]To mark this special occasion, we've just released the highly anticipated [b]Photo Mode[/b] in the full version of the game! [/p][p]We know many of you have been asking for this, and we're thrilled to finally bring it to you. [/p][p]Now you can immerse yourself even deeper in the world of The End of the Sun and capture your favorite moments and breathtaking shots like never before. Get ready to unleash your inner in-game photographer![/p][p][/p][p][b]Check out the new Photo Mode Trailer![/b][/p][previewyoutube="quWxsKUBdk0;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]Important![/h3][p]Photo mode takes screenshots [b]automatically to your Steam library.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Photo Mode Contest![/h2][p][/p][p]To celebrate the launch of Photo Mode, we're kicking off our very first [b]screenshot contest[/b]! Here's how to participate:[/p][list][*][p][b]Take a stunning screenshot[/b] using the new Photo Mode in The End of the Sun Game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Share it on Steam Community Hub[/b] (make sure it's public!).[/p][/*][*][p]Get as many likes as possible! [b]IMPORTANT![/b] [b]A minimum of 50 likes is required to participate in the competition! (Finally, only likes on Steam count)[/b][/p][p](To get more likes, [b]share your screenshot on your social media channels[/b], encourage your friends to like your screenshot, and be sure to tag our official game profile when you post.)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Our social media channels:[/b][/p][p]Facebook: [url="https://www.facebook.com/EndOfTheSunGame"]https://www.facebook.com/EndOfTheSunGame[/url][/p][p]Instagram: [url="https://www.instagram.com/endofsungame/"]https://www.instagram.com/endofsungame/[/url][/p][p]X/Twitter: [url="https://x.com/endofthesungame"]https://x.com/endofthesungame[/url][/p][p]Tik Tok: [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@endofsungame"]https://www.tiktok.com/@endofsungame[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]How to share screenshots? Check out![/b][/p][/*][*][p]Choose a screenshot from your Steam Library on The End of the Sun page[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/b2163cf3765fe91cea5b97aeec79ab2447c30bb8.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Press the right mouse button and click "Share," and after "Share on Steam"[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/96f37571a5920bbd83c46944a2e47fb117ded5fe.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Don't forget to share it publicly! (Visibility section)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/db9fbafecadd1d50e8dd4f5db2c5cf7fec0e608b.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Ready![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]What's in it for you? Awesome prizes, of course![/b][/p][list][*][p][b]1st Place:[/b] A physical [b]Collector's Boxed Edition[/b] of the game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/f565b604a36cc93a5ef6105c3ee5293ea8e7aa9a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]2nd Place:[/b] C[b]opy of the game[/b] for a friend! (Steam key)[/p][/*][*][p][b]3rd Place:[/b] The official [b]The End of the Sun[/b] [b]Soundtrack[/b]! (Steam key)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Special Publisher Choice Award:[/b] The End of the Sun - [b]Soundtrack Edition[/b] (Include game + Soundtrack) (Steam key)[/p][p](An additional prize for the most artistic screenshot! )[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]WHEN?[/h3][p]The contest runs throughout the promotional period, [b]July 20th to August 1st[/b]. Winners will be selected on [b]August 3rd[/b]. The winners and their screenshots will be announced in a separate update. Stay tuned! [/p][p][/p][p][b]We can't wait to see your incredible creations![/b][/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/a8fd5c3cac48171e74f9a37817b9addac935b793.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/1a5f3d17584243d81282fae9cd3b3b8ede7cf215.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/e886091c6054bdbb6749ceaf40370e3116ee5ce6.jpg"][/img][/carousel][hr][/hr][h3]Add a REVIEW :) [/h3][p][/p][p]If you like the game, don't forget to [b]write a REVIEW[/b]! [/p][p]Visit the store page and write [b]even a few words[/b], your thoughts, and your feedback mean a lot for our small team! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/af5136cacc7709dcdd7fd9bdde0f2eefc9f36fdf.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/9d099e56e567fa21501a075c8610a9c023f7609b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for your support![/p]

notes.title: The End of the Sun : Prologue is Available NOW!
notes.content: [h2]The End of the Sun: Prologue is Available NOW![/h2][p][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p] We're thrilled to announce that [b]The End of the Sun: Prologue[/b] is officially here and completely [b]FREE to play[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45686098/f63295cac2f7995ba5877c5d3ab4ebb68e328a1c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]What to Expect in the Prologue[/h3][p][/p][p]The prologue will feature the [b]first mission of the game[/b] and one[b] mission[/b] to showcase the time-travelling mechanics. [/p][p]We created this prologue to give you a taste of the full game and help you decide if The End of the Sun is for you![/p][p][/p][p][b]Step into a world inspired by Slavic myths and legends.[/b][/p][p]As an [b]ashter[/b], a Slavic sorcerer blessed with an incredible gift, you arrive at a mysterious, abandoned village. You find an [b]unusual map[/b] there and begin to explore the area. Initially, you encounter no one, seeing only dimly flickering bonfires. Y[b]our power, however, allows you to connect with the fire[/b], to see visions, and to shape the seemingly ordinary fates of the villagers. Each rekindled bonfire presents a unique challenge steeped in Slavic legends.[/p][p]Dive in and experience the beginning of this unique adventure. We can't wait for you to explore the secrets within![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45686098/582d2cb48bc11a2fca1a46ebc92bb20686f8a16e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45686098/199316bf442cb29f825d4eb9136e2e50a51109fc.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45686098/fcd1eeed336cce4833046b0fb0997242735809b6.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Wishlist, PLAY, and Write a REVIEW![/h2][p][/p][p]We'd be incredibly grateful if you could [b]add it to your wishlist[/b]! It might seem like just one click, but it significantly boosts our visibility on Steam and helps us out a lot![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820900/The_End_of_the_Sun_Prologue/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you like the game, don't forget to [b]write a REVIEW on the The End of the Sun: Prologue page[/b]! [/p][p]Visit the prologue store page and write [b]even a few words[/b], your thoughts, and your feedback mean a lot for our small team! :)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45686098/af5136cacc7709dcdd7fd9bdde0f2eefc9f36fdf.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]DO YOU LIKE THE PROLOGUE? [/h2][h3]CHECK OUT THE FULL VERSION OF THE END OF THE SUN HERE![/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/912840/The_End_of_the_Sun/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]The full version of The End of the Sun, in addition to its extensive and immersive gameplay and story, also includes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Photo Mode[/b] - Get ready to capture your favorite in-game moments like never before![/p][p][b](Available on this Sunday (July 20th)[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45686098/d36262d1ca6c59f6c869a13362f47c3c197cda63.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Community Items - [b]Trading cards[/b], Badges, Profile Backgrounds, Emoticons![/p][p](Available now!)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45686098/d7da2a31d56c8747b3a28c99fd056a6fc2eec0a9.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]40 achievements[/b] - Get them all![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45686098/611a7f2262b965abe00a8c8e2887102f55b7fcf7.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][h3]TRUE INDIE GAME! YOUR HELP MEANS A LOT TO US![/h3][p][/p][p]As you know, The End of the Sun is a true indie game. Created for over 8 years with passion, mainly by a two-person team.[/p][p]We’d be thrilled if you could spread the word about our game on your social media, gaming forums you frequent, Discord groups, or even your own gaming channels. [/p][p]Whether it's a post, a share, or even just telling a friend, every bit of support means the world to us and helps get the word out about The End of The Sun.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45686098/9d099e56e567fa21501a075c8610a9c023f7609b.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]We can't wait to hear your thoughts and feedback about the prologue![/h3][p][/p][p]Thanks![/p][hr][/hr]

notes.title: The End of the Sun: Prologue is Coming!
notes.content: [h2]The End of the Sun: Prologue is Coming![/h2][p][/p][p]We've just launched the [b]Coming Soon page[/b] for [b]The End of the Sun: Prologue[/b] on Steam![/p][p][/p][p]Don't miss it! The prologue will premiere on [b]July 18, 2025, at 5:00 PM  CET, and [/b]will be [b]completely free to play![/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820900/The_End_of_the_Sun_Prologue/" style="button"]WISHLIST PROLOGUE NOW![/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/841913613dde1cf4551004aab4d27d37d7badb7c.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Wishlist Now![/h3][p][/p][p]We'd be incredibly grateful if you could [b]add it to your wishlist[/b] right now. It might seem like just one click, but it significantly boosts our visibility on Steam and helps us out a lot![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820900/The_End_of_the_Sun_Prologue/"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]What to Expect in the Prologue[/h3][p][/p][p]The prologue will feature the [b]first mission of the game[/b] and one [b]additional mission[/b] to showcase the time-travelling mechanics. We created this prologue to give you a taste of the full game and help you decide if The End of the Sun is for you! [/p][p][/p][h3]I have the full version of the game. Can I help?[/h3][p]Yes! Even if you have already played the full version, please wishlist Prologue and write a review after Release, it will help us a lot to stay in indie development and make next games. Thank You![/p][hr][/hr][p]We can't wait to hear your thoughts and feedback![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/9d099e56e567fa21501a075c8610a9c023f7609b.jpg"][/img][/p]
